extracted.name: Honey Glazed Chicken
extracted.description: Delicious honey chicken made with pan-fried chicken breast cubes glazed with a sticky-sweet sauce of honey, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes.
ingredient_lines: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into bite-size pieces
instruction_lines: Whisk honey, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes in a bowl; set aside.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir chicken in hot oil until lightly brown, about 5 minutes.
Pour honey mixture into the skillet; continue to cook and stir until chicken is no longer pink in the center and sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes more.
